Also, incorporating abstractions like an abstract state or special final/shutdown states will help model lifecycle clearly.

create class StateMachine
create containment states in StateMachine type State [1..*]
create containment transitions in StateMachine type Transition [0..*]

# Abstract State to model general state behavior
create abstract class State
create attribute name in State type String

# States can have entry actions (e.g., for audit logging)

# Special concrete states inheriting from State

NormalState extends State

create class FinalState

create attribute conditionExpression in Guard type String

# Audit log entry class

create attribute message in AuditLogEntry type String
